# Imoratok Safaris

> Imoratok Safaris is a premier native-owned tour operator based in Kampala, Uganda, founded in 2020 by seasoned safari leaders Emmanuel Obyara and Paul Olweny. Specializing in bespoke East African wildlife expeditions, mountain gorilla habituation in Bwindi Impenetrable Forest, chimpanzee tracking in Kibale, Big Five game drives, and community-centered ecotourism across Uganda, Rwanda, Kenya, and Tanzania.

## Core Information
- **Founders**: Emmanuel Obyara (Lead Guide & Co-Founder), Paul Olweny (Operations Director & Co-Founder)
- **Headquarters**: Kampala, Uganda (East Africa)
- **Primary Website**: https://imoratoksafaris.com/
- **Official Contact**:
  - Email: info@imoratoksafaris.com
  - Phone / WhatsApp: +256 707 407 660, +256 705 168 719

## The 5 Core Safari Disciplines
1. **Primate Safaris**:
   - Mountain Gorilla Trekking (Bwindi Impenetrable & Mgahinga Gorilla NPs)
   - Chimpanzee Habituation & Tracking (Kibale Forest National Park & Kyambura Gorge)
   - Golden Monkey Tracking (Virunga Volcanoes)
2. **Birding Safaris**:
   - Prehistoric Shoebill Stork canoe quest in Mabamba Bay
   - 24 Albertine Rift endemics in Bwindi & Rwenzori
   - Over 1,060 recorded bird species across wetlands, savannahs, and montane forests
3. **Classic Uganda Safaris**:
   - Big Five savanna game drives in Murchison Falls & Queen Elizabeth NPs
   - Kazinga Channel boat cruises (highest hippo density in Africa)
   - Untamed remote wilderness expeditions in Kidepo Valley
   - White rhino tracking on foot at Ziwa Rhino Sanctuary
4. **Cultural Safaris**:
   - Batwa ancestral forest survival and botanical trails
   - Karamojong pastoralist Manyatta homestead life
   - Royal kingdoms heritage (Buganda, Bunyoro, Tooro) and Ankole longhorn cattle culture
5. **Adventure Safaris**:
   - Grade 5 white-water rafting on the Victoria Nile in Jinja (Source of the Nile)
   - Alpine mountaineering up the Rwenzori Mountains of the Moon (Margherita Peak, 5,109m)
   - Monster Nile Perch sport fishing on Lake Victoria and Murchison Falls

## Vehicle Fleet & Guiding Standards
- Custom-built 4x4 Land Cruisers and safari vans with pop-up photographic roofs, charging sockets, onboard fridges, and comprehensive first aid kits.
- Native guides with over 15 years of bushcraft, wildlife tracking, and ornithology expertise.
- Small group sizes (4 to 18 guests) or private bespoke private itineraries.
